Teerth Sharma

Teerth Sharma is 20 years old, a performance and systems engineer from India. He finds quadratic algorithms nobody noticed and makes them linear. Google DeepMind, Google, TensorFlow, NVIDIA and OpenAI's Triton have each merged his proof.

Merged Pull Requests

1. google-deepmind/mujoco #3396: 1,281.6x less scratch memory (ntree=4,096, 84,033,568 B to 65,568 B).
2. google-deepmind/mujoco_warp #1541: 1.513x faster (geometric mean, 99% CI [1.406x, 1.584x]). Median 156.738 us to 101.097 us.
3. google-deepmind/mujoco #3450: 15,361x fewer probes at V=40,962.
4. google/highway #3244: 65.5x fewer comparisons at one million keys (894,081,141 to 13,643,737).
5. google/XNNPACK #10801: 6.42% lower peak memory (MobileNet V1, 23.862980 to 22.331730 MiB).
6. tensorflow/tensorflow #124410: Correctness fix. Four control edges reduced to three (transitive reduction of collective control edges).
7. NVIDIA/NeMo-Relay #481: One unchanging scaffold now keys to one profile instead of one per task (23 files).
8. triton-lang/kernels #22: Topology-derived sparse attention kernel. 804 lines added, 17 tests passing.
